services.title: Three kinds of projects, one standard: they run in production, with real customers.

items.title: Conversational agents
items.description: Assistants that answer questions, qualify leads and book appointments using your real calendar, prices and policies — connected to the systems you already use, not a generic chatbot.

items.title: Workflow automation & integrations
items.description: The tools you already pay for, connected so data moves on its own: lead capture, enrichment, notifications and reporting — with logs and alerts so you know when something breaks.

items.title: Full-stack web apps & SaaS
items.description: From a fast site that answers your customers' questions to a multi-tenant product: data model, authentication, permissions and an interface people actually use.

process.title: Monitoring isn't a phase at the end. It ships with the first release.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.description: We map the workflow, the systems involved and what "working" means in numbers before anything gets built.

steps.title: Prototype
steps.description: A small working version on your real data, so decisions are made on something you can try — not on a slide.

steps.title: Production, with QA & monitoring
steps.description: Error alerts, logs and a periodic QA review are built from day one. Agents fail in quiet ways; you need to see it before your customers do.

steps.title: Maintenance
steps.description: I keep watching, fixing and improving the system as your business changes.
